audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows disagreed with the packet chart on both layers: Level 2 read Illaoi where whys[1] says short trades 'come out even', Level 6 read Skill where whys[4] and spikes[1] both call the Realm a 1v1 you win, and First item read Illaoi where whys[5] says you cash the isolated all-in.
audit.why: The packet chart is Skill / Skill / Illaoi / Skill / Mordekaiser / Skill / Illaoi over 2191 games at 55.56% — the largest sample in this slice. Giving away the level-6 row on a matchup whose entire win condition is the level-6 ultimate is the worst single row on the page.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 4 and 5 set to Skill / Mordekaiser / Skill as one atomic group across both layers, with the Level 6 rating raised to 7/10, and phases[5].why rewritten to argue the Skill row through her passive healing.

audit.why: Spikes are accurate and correctly ordered: level 3 when the E-pull answers her field, level 6 for the Realm, first item, then her two-item field. Left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Harsh Lesson is not mentioned anywhere on this page — not in the full layer, not in the content layer, not once. Test of Spirit had no cooldown. Nothing stated that her passive heals her off tentacle hits.
audit.why: Harsh Lesson is a 4-second dash that is also an auto-attack reset and pulls every nearby tentacle onto its target — it is how she closes on you and how she opens every trade, and a page that tells you to 'trade on her E cooldown' while omitting a 4-second gap-closer is giving you a window that does not exist. Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12, so the gap you play around is 16 seconds at rank 1. Prophet of an Elder God heals her whenever a tentacle damages a champion, which is why extended trades inside her field do not close.
audit.corrected: Harsh Lesson's 4s cooldown, dash and auto-reset written into breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[1].d; Test of Spirit's 16s into dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns; the tentacle heal and Grievous Wounds into dontsFull[0].d and phases[5].why.
sources: enemyKit Illaoi W cd 4, dash and autoReset flags, text

notes: MIRROR CONFLICT — read this before applying. The mirror audit (illaoi__mordekaiser) reports flipping rows 0 and 3 to Illaoi and rows 5 and 6 to Skill. My packet chart for this direction reads Skill / Skill / Illaoi / Skill / Mordekaiser / Skill / Illaoi. The two agree on rows 4 and 5 and disagree on rows 0, 3 and 6. I applied only the rows where the packet and the mirror do not conflict (1, 4, 5) and deliberately left rows 0, 3 and 6 untouched rather than pick a side and have mirror-fix overwrite it either way. This needs one human ruling; it is in questionsForUser. Both flagged suspectNames are false positives — 'Land Test of Spirit' and 'Her Test of Spirit' are the real name with a verb or pronoun in front. On the third missing-interaction (terrain-cuts-retreat): Riot's passive text says tentacles spawn ON nearby impassable terrain, it does not say she creates terrain, so I wrote nothing about her walling off your retreat — the derived flag misfires on that tooltip. Same for the kit file's 'grounding' flag on Obliterate, which Riot's Q text does not support, so I made no claim about it stopping Harsh Lesson.
